prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one simple landscape game header/banner for a Chinese 2D factory-building game.
Create a wide 16:9 banner for the game titled exactly "喂——出来". Use restrained, simple pixel art consistent with industrial top-down game assets: visibly crisp square pixels, limited grey steel / rust brown / muted earth palette, 2–3 shadow tones, a few warm amber machine lights. Factory-planning clarity inspired by Factorio, without copying its logo or UI.
Scene: a small underground recycling settlement, seen from an elevated overhead angle. A heap of discarded wood, metal and plastic on one side feeds a short conveyor into two clearly silhouetted scrap-built industrial machines. A small dark circular stone-rimmed hole lies near the heap. The surrounding floor is plain and spacious. These objects are the main scene; keep it uncluttered and readable as a small thumbnail. No cross-section of three civilizations, combat, invaders, spacecraft, extra buildings, menus or interface.
Composition: horizontal cover, title in a clean quiet upper area, factory scene across the lower two thirds. Large legible cream-coloured pixel/block Chinese lettering, exact text "喂——出来" (喂, two em-dashes ——, 出, 来). No exclamation mark, no book-title brackets, no subtitle, no slogan, no English lettering, no watermark. Keep all letters comfortably inside the frame with generous margins.
Mood: practical, modest beginnings, waste becoming useful resources. Flat pixel shading; avoid painterly gradients, realistic materials, glossy 3D, fine noise and excessive mechanical details. Opaque background. Generate only one finished banner.
